title: CLI Manifest Terminal Continuation and Runtime Trace

checks.name: cli-scan-operation-has-interface-first-export
checks.detail: CLI scan factory is exported as a named, explicitly typed operation object.

checks.name: composition-factory-has-interface-first-export
checks.detail: Manifest composition factory uses the declared interface as its runtime contract.

checks.name: composition-authority-is-interface-typed
checks.detail: Canonical production authority is constructed through the typed factory.

checks.name: manifest-result-is-operational-adt
checks.detail: Every manifest terminal outcome carries a domain continuation.

checks.name: manifest-builder-outcomes-use-upstream-continuation
checks.detail: Complete/blocked builder outcomes are translated through the producer-owned continuation.

checks.name: cli-command-consumes-manifest-adt
checks.detail: CLI scan consumes the manifest terminal ADT through its operation.

checks.name: scan-no-undefined-validation-sentinel
checks.detail: Manifest validation rejection is handled at its ADT terminal, not encoded as undefined sentinel data.

checks.name: scan-rejection-is-domain-handler
checks.detail: Rejected validation is handled directly by the rejected-result continuation.

checks.name: scan-sync-share-one-manifest-operation
checks.detail: Scan and sync both use the composition-owned manifest scan operation.

checks.name: cli-composition-uses-typed-scan-factory
checks.detail: CLI composition reuses the canonical scan operation factory.

checks.name: no-export-function-in-traced-composition-modules
checks.detail: Traced composition/scan operation modules contain no exported function declarations.
